My research interests lie in **the representation theory of finite-dimensional algebras**, **quivers**, and their **homological and combinatorial properties**.

## Current preprint

**[Minimal presentations of finite-dimensional representations of pseudocompact algebras](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18805)**  
Christof Geiss, Carolin Hartung, Daniel Labardini-Fragoso and Jan Schröer. *Preprint* (2026), 26 pages.

[Read the preprint on arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18805)

## Research group

I am a PhD student at the University of Bonn under the supervision of [Jan Schröer](https://www.math.uni-bonn.de/~schroer/).

For presentations connected to my interests, see [Talks](talks.qmd).
